contracts.name: windowByCount
contracts.signature: function windowByCount(text: string, start: number, count: number): string

preconditions: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Start is an integer between zero and the text length; count is an integer from 0 through 64.
